🚪 Panel Admin Filament ​

Panel admin adalah pintu utama dashboard CMS.

📁 File yang Diedit ​

txt
app/Providers/Filament/AdminPanelProvider.php

🧩 Kode Utama ​

php
return $panel
    ->default()
    ->id('admin')
    ->path('admin')
    ->login()
    ->colors([
        'primary' => Color::Amber,
    ])
    ->discoverResources(in: app_path('Filament/Resources'), for: 'App\\Filament\\Resources')
    ->discoverPages(in: app_path('Filament/Pages'), for: 'App\\Filament\\Pages')
    ->pages([
        Pages\Dashboard::class,
    ])
    ->widgets([
        Widgets\AccountWidget::class,
        NewsletterStatsWidget::class,
        Widgets\FilamentInfoWidget::class,
    ]);

🔗 Mengubah URL Admin ​

Kode saat ini:

php
->path('admin')

Jika ingin dashboard menjadi /dashboard:

php
->path('dashboard')

🎨 Mengubah Warna Utama Panel ​

Kode saat ini:

php
->colors([
    'primary' => Color::Amber,
])

Contoh ubah ke biru:

php
->colors([
    'primary' => Color::Blue,
])

🧩 Menambah atau Menghapus Widget ​

Widget dashboard didaftarkan di bagian:

php
->widgets([
    Widgets\AccountWidget::class,
    NewsletterStatsWidget::class,
    Widgets\FilamentInfoWidget::class,
])

Jika ingin menghapus widget info Filament:

php
->widgets([
    Widgets\AccountWidget::class,
    NewsletterStatsWidget::class,
])

🔐 Login dan Middleware ​

Kode:

php
->login()
->authMiddleware([
    Authenticate::class,
])

Artinya dashboard wajib login sebelum bisa diakses.
